title: RelayEnvelope
description: One frame on a Relay connection (FR-137, ADR-071, docs/22 §3.1). The Relay sees only these outer fields; ct is XChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext sealed end to end to the recipient's device key, with client, stream, seq and seg bound as associated data so the Relay cannot reorder, splice or replay frames undetected.

to.description: Recipient routing id issued at pairing; never a device name.

stream.description: One per logical channel: a thread stream, a server request, a file transfer.

seg.description: Segment index and count; payloads above 64 KiB are split, up to 16 MiB per message.

ack.description: Cumulative: the highest contiguous seq received on this stream in the other direction. May ride on data frames.

ct.description: base64(nonce || ciphertext || tag); at most one 64 KiB segment of plaintext.
